answer: One fake locks 180 POA for 10 epochs, but the tenth fake from one funder locks 990 POA, because each basalt bond rises 90 POA if funded within 7 epochs of the last. Each epoch the beacon draws 3 verifiers from a garden tenured over 5 epochs; each sends a pigment nonce and the key must reply hash(pigment, key, epoch) within 1 epoch, so replies cannot be copied across fakes. One miss burns 15%, two slash the bond and zero the weight. Ten fakes lock 5,850 POA, 100 lock 463,500 POA, versus at most 25 POA per epoch. A rich patient attacker can still pay, so verifiers must rotate and risk slashing.
